example.title: Example output
example.note: Illustrative example of a Studio brief.
example.x:
1/ A new open-source agent SDK just shipped tool use and tracing out of the box.
2/ Why it matters: you no longer glue three libraries together to debug an agent.
3/ Here is what changed and what it means for your stack 👇
example.linkedin: Agent tooling just got simpler. The new SDK ships tracing and tool use by default — the two things teams usually build themselves. If you run agents in production, this is worth a look this week.
example.shorts: "You've been debugging AI agents the hard way. This new SDK fixes that in one line."

accuracy.a: Every story is built only from its linked sources, which are always shown. Check them before you publish.

copyright.a: No. We show our own short summary and link to the original sources.

ai.a: AI summarizes clustered sources and drafts content you edit. Drafts include an AI-use disclosure.

freshness.a: Sources are checked every 15–60 minutes and scores update every 30 minutes.
